_comment: The words of the diner, the street, the races and their results: the screens' labels, the loading screen, the
messages after a race (results, the police, events, Assetto Corsa's own troubles), the timeslip and the dial-in,
the racing hub (racehub.*) and its track picker (trackpicker.*), event entry and its rules, the victory sheet. A label is said one way (the first line of its pool). {name} is a
value the game fills in, {name:N0} a number written with its thousands, {name:MMM d} a date written that way. A
line that starts or ends with a space keeps it: it is joined to others. \n breaks the line. The placeholders:
challenge.not_set_up, challenge.car_wont_run, raceload.failed, raceload.error, launch.mode_not_installed, launch.not_put_back.problem, launch.not_put_back.cars, launch.not_put_back.cfg: {problem}

cruise.alongside, result.abandoned, result.disqualified, result.rival_disqualified, result.bracket.lost, result.bracket.rival_broke_out, result.forfeit.pink_slip, police.busted, police.busted.both, police.pink_slip, police.rival_busted, police.rival_impounded: {name}
timeslip.eighth.speed, timeslip.quarter.speed: {unit} the speed's unit, in capitals
trackpicker.length: {length} the track's length, in the player's units

lines.diner.title: The Main Street Diner
lines.diner.about.mainstreet: Where everybody starts out: sixes, small V8s and small bets on Main Street.
lines.diner.about.hiway: A truck stop grill out by the yards. The regulars have some iron under the hood and race for a bit more.
lines.diner.about.surfside: The coffee shop on the strip by the beach, where the fast cars park out front and the bets get serious.
lines.diner.about.starlite: The Googie palace up on the boulevard. The big names, the big engines and the big money. The King eats here.
lines.diner.snub.note: The regulars here don't race anything under {power}. Come back with more under the hood.
lines.diner.cruise.tooltip: Sit at the curb with the engine running and see who pulls up
lines.diner.map.tooltip: Drive off and pick another diner on the map
lines.diner.no_tracks: No tracks available. Check your Assetto Corsa installation.
lines.diner.format.about.time_attack: A warm-up lap, then three flying laps each. You run as ghosts, so nobody gets pushed off: the best lap wins.
lines.diner.bracket: Run it as a bracket race
lines.diner.bracket.about: Each of you dials in the time you'll run. The slower car leaves first, by the difference; first to the quarter wins, but running under your dial-in is a breakout and loses.
lines.diner.select_opponent: Select an opponent from the list
lines.diner.bracket.rival_dial_in: {name} would dial in {dial_in}. You pick yours before the race.

lines.diner.no_car: You need to select a car in your garage first!

Your car is not going anywhere: {problem}.

Sort it out in the garage first.
lines.challenge.car_wont_run.title: Car Won't Run
lines.raceload.stop.title: Stop Race
lines.raceload.stop.not_started:
Call the race off?

Assetto Corsa has not started yet, so nothing is lost.
lines.raceload.stop.tune:
Leave the strip now?

The passes you ran still count: their timeslips, and what they did to the car.
lines.raceload.stop.at_stake:
Stop Assetto Corsa now?

Stopping before the finish counts as a loss: what was at stake is lost.

Stop Assetto Corsa now?

The race will not count.
lines.raceload.result_pending: The result is not in yet...

lines.launch.in_progress: Cannot launch: another execution is in progress
lines.launch.busy.title: Assetto Corsa Is Busy
lines.launch.busy.putting_back: Assetto Corsa is still running, or what an earlier race changed in it is still being put back. Try again once it has closed.
lines.launch.busy.running: Assetto Corsa is already running (opened from Content Manager or Steam, or still closing). Close it, then try again.
lines.launch.not_settled: The last race has not been settled yet
lines.launch.stopped: The launch was stopped before Assetto Corsa started. Nothing was raced.
lines.launch.stuck: Assetto Corsa did not close when it was stopped.
lines.launch.failed_to_load: Assetto Corsa closed right after it started; it most likely failed to load. Nothing was raced.
lines.launch.no_csp: Custom Shaders Patch is not installed in Assetto Corsa: races need it.
lines.launch.mode_missing: The race mode is missing from the game's folder ({folder}).
lines.launch.mode_folder_taken: Another mode is installed in Assetto Corsa under the name this race format's mode uses ({folder}), and it is not the game's: the format's mode cannot go in there. Move that folder away to race in this format.
lines.launch.mode_not_installed: The race mode could not be installed into Assetto Corsa: {problem}
lines.launch.unsettled.title: Race Not Settled Yet
lines.launch.unsettled.stuck: Assetto Corsa did not close when the race was stopped. The race is settled once it has closed; nothing is lost in the meantime.
lines.launch.unsettled.running: Assetto Corsa is still running. The race is settled once it has closed; nothing is lost in the meantime.
lines.launch.unsettled.not_recorded: The race ended without a result, but that could not be recorded just now. It is settled the next time this save is loaded, or before your next race.
lines.launch.result_waiting.title: Race Result Waiting
lines.launch.result_waiting: The race's result is there but could not be read just now. Nothing is lost: it counts as soon as the game can read it (when this save is loaded again, or before your next race).
lines.launch.result_unusable.title: Race Results
lines.launch.result_unusable: The race wrote a result the game could not use, so nothing was changed. The file is kept for a look; the details are in the log.
lines.launch.no_result.title: No Result
lines.launch.no_result: The race ended before the finish, so it does not count.
lines.launch.not_put_back.title: Assetto Corsa Not Put Back
lines.launch.not_put_back.cars: The cars' data could not be put back ({problem}).
lines.launch.not_put_back.cfg: The cfg files could not be put back ({problem}).
lines.launch.not_put_back.car: {car}: its data could not all be put back; the originals are kept under {folder} and go back at the next start.
lines.launch.not_put_back.original_gone: {car}: the original of {file} is no longer kept, so the race version stays in {folder}.
lines.launch.not_put_back.copy: The race copy {folder} could not be deleted; the next start tries again.
lines.cruise.no_street: The street can't be shown on this machine, but the racers still come by.
lines.cruise.rev.tooltip: Hold to rev your engine (or hold the space bar)
lines.cruise.look_hint: Drag to look around · double-click to look back out
lines.cruise.pull_over: You pull over to the curb and let the engine idle.
lines.cruise.late_night: The street's gone quiet. You head home and call it a night.

lines.cruise.no_tracks: Nowhere to race: no tracks are installed.
lines.cruise.headlights: Headlights in the mirror. Somebody's pulling up...
lines.cruise.alongside: {name} pulls up alongside and rolls the window down.
lines.cruise.waved_off: You wave {name} off. The {car} pulls away.
lines.result.came_in.title: Race Result
lines.result.came_in: The result of the race you left running while the game was closed has come in, and it counts.
lines.result.last_not_settled.title: Last Race Not Settled
lines.result.last_not_settled:
The result of your last race has not been read yet (Assetto Corsa is still running, or its result file is busy).

Try again in a moment: it has to count before the next race can start.
lines.result.last_unusable.title: Last Race
lines.result.last_unusable: Your last race wrote a result the game could not use, so it does not count and nothing was lost. The file is kept for a look; the details are in the log.

lines.result.tune.title: Test and Tune
lines.result.tune.new_best: A new best for your car.
lines.result.tune.no_pass: You never made a full pass: there's no timeslip to take home.
lines.result.abandoned.title: Out of the Race
lines.result.abandoned: You left the race before the finish, and that counts as a loss to {name}.
lines.result.disqualified.title: Disqualified
lines.result.disqualified: You hit {name} in his own lane. That's a DQ, and the race is his.
lines.result.rival_disqualified.title: Rival Disqualified
lines.result.rival_disqualified: {name} hit you in your own lane. That's a DQ, and the race is yours.

lines.result.broke_down: Your {what} before the line. The race is {name}'s.
lines.result.rival_broke_down.title: Rival Broke Down
lines.result.rival_broke_down: {name}'s {what} before the line. The race is yours.
lines.result.nobody_finished.title: Nobody Finished
lines.result.nobody_finished: Neither car made it to the line. It's a draw, and nothing changes hands.
lines.result.breakout.title: Breakout
